mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM sys_user account JOIN sys_user_role membership ON membership.user_id = account.user_id JOIN sys_role role_entry ON role_entry.role_id = membership.role_id AND role_entry.tenant_id = account.tenant_id WHERE account.user_id = #{actorId} AND account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0' AND role_entry.deleted = 0 AND role_entry.status = '0' AND (role_entry.role_key = 'admin' OR (account.user_id = #{ownerId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_menu permission_entry JOIN sys_menu menu_entry ON menu_entry.menu_id = permission_entry.menu_id WHERE permission_entry.role_id = role_entry.role_id AND menu_entry.status = '0' AND menu_entry.perms = 'oa:rfq:invite' )))

SELECT account.user_id AS id, account.tenant_id, account.nick_name AS name, account.user_id, account.dept_id, department.dept_name FROM sys_user account LEFT JOIN sys_dept department ON department.dept_id = account.dept_id AND department.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND department.deleted = 0 WHERE account.user_id = #{id} AND account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0'
SELECT dept_id AS id, tenant_id, dept_name AS name, dept_id, dept_name, parent_id, leader FROM sys_dept WHERE dept_id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0'
SELECT user_id AS id, tenant_id, user_id, dept_id, nick_name AS name FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT employee.id, employee.tenant_id, employee.name, employee.user_id, employee.dept_id, position.level_id AS job_level_id FROM hr_employee employee LEFT JOIN hr_position position ON position.id = employee.position_id AND position.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id WHERE employee.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee.deleted = 0 AND employee.employee_status NOT IN ('RESIGNED', 'TERMINATED')
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, level_name AS name FROM hr_job_level WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 1
SELECT id, tenant_id, level_name AS name FROM hr_job_level WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY level_rank, id
SELECT id, tenant_id, name, user_id, dept_id FROM hr_employee WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_employee employee INNER JOIN sys_user account ON account.user_id = employee.user_id AND account.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id AND account.deleted = 0 WHERE employee.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee.user_id = #{userId} AND employee.deleted = 0

SELECT user_id AS id, tenant_id, user_id, nick_name AS name, dept_id FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND (CAST(user_id AS CHAR) = #{value} OR user_name = #{value} OR nick_name = #{value}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN CAST(user_id AS CHAR) = #{value} THEN 0 WHEN user_name = #{value} THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, user_id
